title: Listing card
description: One page of a listing, as the list view shows it: its title as a link, its date, its teaser and its tags. It takes a page of the listing as it is.

title.description: The page's title, as the card's link

description.description: The teaser: the page's description, or its first paragraph. At most three lines are shown

tags.description: The page's tags: each its label, linked to its tag page when the site has one
